prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: An art classroom with children drawing circles, painting pictures and making cards safely. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Art Class". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Art class, paper, paint, crayon.
Draw one circle, work with you.
Design one image, color the page.
Scissors for the adult, please.
Print one picture, make one card.
Show the beauty, try one thing new.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
